name: plantini-e2e
description: Contract-driven Playwright tests for Plantini's release-critical user journeys

scripts.test: npm run check:environment && node ./scripts/run-with-e2e-env.mjs playwright test
scripts.test:health: npm run check:environment && node ./scripts/run-with-e2e-env.mjs playwright test --project=health
scripts.test:contract: npm run check:environment && node ./scripts/run-with-e2e-env.mjs playwright test --project=contract
scripts.test:core: npm run check:environment && node ./scripts/run-with-e2e-env.mjs playwright test --project=web-app
scripts.test:resilience: npm run check:environment && node ./scripts/run-with-e2e-env.mjs playwright test --project=resilience
scripts.test:accessibility: npm run check:environment && node ./scripts/run-with-e2e-env.mjs playwright test --project=accessibility
